name: Create
description: Insert a row into an existing database table using configured or connected JSON values.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Optional JSON object of column values. Overrides configured values when connected.

controllers.name: connection
controllers.description: Database connection controller from a database node.

parameters.name: schema_name
parameters.description: Optional PostgreSQL schema. Ignored for SQLite.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: JSON object of column names to inserted values.
